title: GingersAttic Seller Agreement
status: DRAFT for the owner's review. This is not legal advice; have it checked before real sellers sign up.
intro: GingersAttic is a virtual antique mall. You decorate a booth, list your own items, and we sell them for you through the GingersAttic store on consignment. By ticking "I agree" you accept these terms.

p: You keep ownership of your items until they sell. GingersAttic lists and sells them for you through its online store, and shoppers pay GingersAttic.
You must own every item you list (or have the owner's permission to sell it) and have the right to sell it.
Use real photos of the actual item, not stock images. Describe it honestly: give its measurements, choose the right condition, and mention chips, cracks, repairs, missing parts and replaced pieces.
If an item is a reproduction, a reissue or you aren't sure of its age, say so. Pick "Unknown" for the era rather than guessing.
GingersAttic reviews every new item before shoppers can see it, and may decline or remove any listing at any time.
Price and quantity changes go live immediately. Changes to photos, the title, the description or the details go back for review; the approved version stays up meanwhile.
GingersAttic keeps a 15% commission on each item's sale price. The shipping the buyer pays at checkout (calculated by USPS from the item's weight and size) is passed to you to cover postage.
Payouts are made once a month for items that have been delivered. An item counts as delivered once you've marked it shipped and either 14 days have passed or GingersAttic has confirmed delivery.
GingersAttic will ask you how you'd like to be paid before your first payout.
When an item sells you'll get an email and see the order on your My Sales page. Ship it within 3 business days, packed well enough to survive the trip, and add the tracking number on My Sales.

Everything ships by USPS within the United States. Shipping is calculated by USPS at checkout from the weight and size you enter, so measure and weigh carefully. Insured shipping is strongly recommended for anything fragile or over $100.

GingersAttic ships within the United States only for now. When international sales open, buyers pay any customs duties and import taxes, and sellers must follow export rules; items that can't legally be exported to the buyer's country will not be sold there.

Shoppers can't return items because they changed their mind. If an item doesn't arrive, or is significantly not as described, GingersAttic may refund the buyer; that sale isn't paid out, or is taken off your next payout if it was already paid.
If you sell an item somewhere else, lower its quantity or take it down at once. If you can't fill an order, tell GingersAttic immediately. Repeated cancellations can lead to your booth being closed.

Buyers and sellers deal with each other only through GingersAttic. Don't put a phone number, email or street address, social media handle or website link in your listings, photos or booth, and don't offer or accept a sale of anything you list here outside GingersAttic.
Questions from shoppers come to GingersAttic, which passes them to you and sends your answer back to the shopper.

Why: it protects buyers and sellers from scams and fraud, it keeps every sale covered by GingersAttic's payment, refund and delivery checks, and it keeps the mall fair to every seller who pays the commission.
GingersAttic collects sales tax on store sales where the law requires it. You're responsible for your own income taxes on what you earn.
You keep the rights to your photos and descriptions. You let GingersAttic display, crop, cut out the background of, and share them to list and promote your items and your booth.
Don't list anything on the prohibited items list below. GingersAttic may remove such items without notice, and repeated attempts can close your booth.

Items made with human hair, such as Victorian hair lockets, hair work and mourning jewelry, are allowed if they are antique or vintage and the listing says they contain human hair. Other human remains, such as teeth and bone, stay prohibited.
You can close your booth at any time, and GingersAttic can close it if these terms aren't followed. Orders already placed must still be shipped, and completed sales are still paid out.
If these terms change, you'll be asked to agree to the new version before adding more items.

prohibitedIntro: These can't be sold at GingersAttic, even as antiques:
prohibited: Firearms, ammunition, gun parts, explosives, fireworks, and weapons such as switchblades or brass knuckles
Ivory, tortoiseshell, rhino horn, and parts of endangered or protected animals (including feathers and taxidermy of protected species)
Human remains, including skulls, bones and teeth (antique or vintage items made with human hair are allowed when the listing says so)
Hazardous materials: asbestos items, mercury, radioactive items (other than ordinary uranium glass), pesticides and chemicals
Recalled or unsafe children's items: cribs, car seats, baby walkers, toys with lead paint sold for children's use
Alcohol, tobacco, vaping products, drugs, drug paraphernalia, prescription medicine and medical devices
Counterfeits, fakes, and reproductions sold as originals
Stolen goods, and archaeological or cultural artifacts without lawful provenance
Hate-group items, including Nazi and KKK memorabilia
Currency, coins or stamps that are forgeries, and live tickets or gift cards
Items that copy someone else's trademark or artwork without permission
